verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviews automatically review new pull requests and analyze every PR. Nothing in the evidence shows that pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review, or that the agent tracks which earlier comments were fixed rather than repeating them. Receiving GitHub push webhooks is plumbing, not a documented re-review capability.

support.subject: As a developer, pushing new commits triggers an incremental re-review that tracks what was fixed instead of repeating old comments
